Note – During the presentation of the Budget, the FM alleged that the power sector suffered due to the policies of the YSRCP Government. However, the facts convey a different image. Accumulated losses of DISCOMs have risen to phenomenal levels during the period of the TDP Government and the debt has also grown during the period of the TDP Government at disproportionately high level. *అక్కరలేదు, నీవు చెప్పినది నిజమే. నేను నిన్ను నమ్ముతాను.* Is this a reflection of the TDP's efficiency?
